purpose: Allow bounded framework source discovery, contract compilation, skill generation, tests/evals, documentation, packaging, and gap analysis to proceed in parallel while promotion and activation remain exact-version governed operations.
activation_invariant: Parallelize preparation; serialize promotion under the current Penta/CHLOM authority graph. Precompile evidence never manufactures activation authority.
rollback: Supersede candidate packages and bindings while preserving source/evidence lineage. Precompile alone mutates no provider, customer, financial, rights, or production runtime state.
